title: woma: a real-time foundation model and its fine-tuned models for endoscopy
abstract: arXiv:2609.15130v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: woma is a real-time foundation model for gastrointestinal endoscopy: a network trained without labels on about a million endoscopy frames, from which task models are fine-tuned. We contribute a systematic design for production. Requirements and pass marks were fixed before any run, eight candidates screened under pre-registered rules, self-supervised training taken to a stopping rule, then fine-tuning and deployment optimisation, all on one self-contained library, numbat. We also contribute woma itself with two fine-tuned models, every outcome reported met or missed. Our colonoscopy model finds and outlines polyps, names which colon segment is in view, suggests polyp type and grades bowel preparation. Our gastroscopy model names a station out of 22 protocol sites, flags and outlines lesions, and names one of seven findings. Every number was read on data never seen in training, and shipped weights were chosen on that record. In colonosc

translated_title: woma：一个实时基础模型及其在内窥镜检查中的微调模型
translated_abstract: woma是一个用于胃肠内窥镜检查的实时基础模型：这是一个在大约一百万帧内窥镜图像上进行无标签训练的网络，任务模型从该基础模型微调而来。我们为生产环境贡献了一套系统化设计。需求和合格标准在任何运行之前就已固定，根据预先注册的规则筛选了八个候选模型，自监督训练按停止规则进行，然后进行微调和部署优化，所有这些都在一个独立完整的库numbat中完成。我们还贡献了woma本身以及两个微调模型，所有报告的结果均如实记录达成或未达成。我们的结肠镜检查模型能够发现并勾勒息肉轮廓，识别当前视野中的结肠段，建议息肉类型并评估肠道准备情况。我们的胃镜检查模型能够从22个协议站点中识别当前站点，标记并勾勒病变轮廓，并识别七种发现中的一种。每个数字都是在训练中从未见过的数据上读取的，发布的权重正是基于这一记录选择的。
tldr: woma是一个用于胃肠内窥镜检查的实时基础模型，通过约一百万帧内窥镜图像的无标签自监督训练构建，其微调模型可实现结肠镜和胃镜中的息肉检测、解剖定位、病变识别等多种临床任务，且所有结果均在未见过的数据上严格验证。
en_tdlr: woma is a real-time foundation model for gastrointestinal endoscopy, trained label-free on approximately one million endoscopy frames, with fine-tuned models performing multiple clinical tasks including polyp detection, anatomical localization, and lesion identification in both colonoscopy and gastroscopy, all rigorously validated on unseen data.
